title: Efficient Generation of Fetal Hepatic Stellate Cells From hiPSC.
snippet: Human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived liver organoids have emerged as valuable models for studying human liver development. However, existing organoid systems often lack developmentally matched cell populations, particularly fetal hepatic stellate cells (HSCs), limiting their ability to recapitulate key developmental processes.
